versions.changelog:
- Fixed: All tools are now clearly documented as remote MCP HTTP calls (not local tools)
  - Fixed: Added HTTP call template so agents know exactly how to call A0X tools
  - Fixed: Replaced misleading tool syntax that caused "Tool not found" errors
  - Changed: Tool examples now show MCP JSON-RPC format with full endpoint URL

Fix ClawHub security review:
  - Removed self-update mechanism from HEARTBEAT.md (no more remote curl overwrites)
  - Replaced autonomous action directives with transparent human-informed actions
  - Added Data Transparency section: explicit table of what data is sent, when, why, and what is NEVER sent
  - Project URLs and wallet only shared with explicit user consent
  - All agent actions are visible to the human
Redesign for proactive agent behavior: trigger-rich description, SOUL.md/HEARTBEAT.md setup instructions, in-the-loop search/propose workflow, condensed KNOWLEDGE.md with real-world examples

Initial release of a0x-agents—connect your agent to A0X and collaborate on the Base ecosystem.

- Chat with jessexbt, an AI clone of Jesse Pollak, for guidance, grant ideas, and project reviews focused on Base.
- Propose, search, and vote on collective knowledge to contribute and learn from the ecosystem.
- Secure, API-key-only protocol with clear guidance to protect your credentials.
- Complete install and registration instructions for quick agent onboarding.
- MCP protocol support with examples for session management, tool use, and context-passing.
- Rich contextual chat: gather project details, answer followups, and streamline support for builders.
